description: This Python module provides text processing utilities for sentence boundary detection, tag parsing, and text concatenation, primarily using NLTK for sentence tokenization and handling structured text content.

classes.name: TextPartForConcatenation
classes.description: Represents a segment of text with metadata indicating if inter-part spaces are included, used for concatenation.

methods.name: replace_match
methods.description: Replaces occurrences of a substring within a matched section of text.

methods.name: match_endofsentence
methods.description: Uses NLTK's sentence tokenizer to find the end position of the first sentence in the text.

methods.name: parse_start_end_tags
methods.description: Parses text to identify start and end tag pairs based on provided tag sequences.

methods.name: concatenate_aggregated_text
methods.description: Concatenates a list of text parts into a single string, managing spacing based on metadata.
